UxPlay source code (GPL-3.0-or-later)
=====================================

UxPlay-d29dfabe102aba137170121077f55390e875310c.tar.gz is the unmodified source of
UxPlay 1.74 (development) at commit d29dfabe102aba137170121077f55390e875310c, as
downloaded from https://codeload.github.com/FDH2/UxPlay/tar.gz/d29dfabe102aba137170121077f55390e875310c
(project: https://github.com/FDH2/UxPlay).

SHA-256: d68b043bb7eaf141b506199f0c3aa4b8dc261b4f063cf8ccc9697f22b8539ce2

MirrorDesk changes four files of it (change "mirrordesk.3", 2026-10-21). The changed files
are in mirrordesk/ (copied over the extracted source before building) and the change itself
is mirrordesk.patch (a unified diff against the archive above):

  lib/raop_buffer.c, lib/raop_buffer.h, lib/raop_rtp.c - the AirPlay audio buffer. When the
  phone paused, seeked or started a new video, it carried on with later audio packets, and
  UxPlay kept waiting for the packets it skipped until 256 newer ones had queued up behind
  them (about 2.8 s of sound), then released them all at once: the sound cut out for 1-3 s
  after every pause or seek. The buffer now follows the phone's FLUSH request at once, and a
  missing packet is waited for only briefly (8 packets, to give a resend its chance).
  (mirrordesk.1)

  lib/raop_rtp.c - each FLUSH is also reported on standard output ("MirrorDesk: audio
  flush"), so MirrorDesk stops the old sound at once and starts the new sound with its full
  backlog. (mirrordesk.2)

  renderers/video_renderer.c - video forwarded as RTP (-vrtp) carries the phone's own frame
  time (counted from the stream's first frame) as its timestamp. Without it every frame had
  the same RTP timestamp, so MirrorDesk could not even out frames that Wi-Fi delivers late
  and in bursts (the picture stalled for a moment every 15-20 s). (mirrordesk.3)

MirrorDesk's macOS and Linux installers and its Docker image build the AirPlay receiver
from these files (they check the SHA-256 of the archive first). It is the same commit and
change as the Windows build, so together they are also the corresponding source for the
uxplay program in every MirrorDesk package. The license is in licenses/UxPlay-LICENSE.txt
and inside the archive (LICENSE).
